set.body:
Consumer: storyatlas4s (StoryAtlas ADR 0001, bd-01M35KZHNDM6E2NAQBN8N4YPD8 in that repo).

Need: public picking over a hand-built Scene whose targets are identified by grob name (GraphicsName), not only over a Plot-compiled InteractionPlan.

Evidence at 6120b6c: Picking.compile takes InteractionPlan[A] (constructed only by InteractionCompiler from a Plot); Picking.composition takes ComposedInteraction; the scene-level Picking.fromDeviceScene and the TargetGroup constructor are private[interaction]. StoryAtlas lowers its Atlas, Codex overlay and Recall Voyage figures directly to Grob trees and names every interactive mark with GraphicsName (rendered as SVG data-name). Its web host hit-tests through the DOM; a canvas host (JavaFX, Canvas) has no public way to map a device point to that name.

Smallest additive API (a proposal, not a design decision): e.g. Picking.named(scene: Scene, context: RenderContext, policy: PickPolicy = default): Either[IntaglioError, PickingPlan[GraphicsName]] (or a NamedPickingPlan) returning the GraphicsName of the nearest/hit named grob, reusing the existing geometry, clip, rotation, draw-order and dash semantics. Nested names: innermost name wins, or refuse ambiguity explicitly.

Acceptance: identical hits on JVM and Scala.js for the same scene/context; conformance with SVG data-name placement for group, point-batch and text grobs; additive-API court passes. Out of scope: emphasis rendering, state management.

Until this exists StoryAtlas keeps its Intaglio pin and ships DOM hit-testing only.
set.title: [Interaction] Public picking over a hand-built Scene routed by GraphicsName
